system.name: FlexSP
system.one_liner: a heterogeneity-adaptive sequence parallelism system that solves per-step optimal parallelism plans for LLM training on sequences of varying length

components.name: Solver
components.role: computes the optimal heterogeneous parallelism plan for a batch of varying-length sequences; contains the Sequence Blaster and Parallelism Planner

components.name: Sequence Blaster (§4.2)
components.role: chunks sequences into micro-batches so each micro-batch is not too large to accommodate

components.name: Micro-batch Chunking
components.role: the chunking operation performed by the Sequence Blaster

components.name: Parallelism Planner (§4.1)
components.role: solves the optimal parallelism plan for each micro-batch to minimize its execution time

components.name: Sequence Bucketing
components.role: groups sequences into buckets prior to solving

components.name: Parallelism Solving
components.role: solves for the optimal combination of parallelism strategies per bucket, formulated as a linear-programming optimization

components.name: Executor
components.role: carries out the training of one iteration following the solver's optimal plan

flows.what: varied-length input data prefetched for the next iteration
Optimal Plan, executed for the current iteration

content.key_idea: FlexSP's Solver chunks a batch of varying-length sequences into micro-batches, buckets and solves an optimal heterogeneous parallelism plan, which the Executor then runs for the current training iteration while the solver prefetches the next.
content.reading_order: left-to-right through the Solver's Sequence Blaster then Parallelism Planner (top-down bucketing to solving), then down to the Executor consuming the resulting optimal plan

summary: Figure 3 is FlexSP's system overview, showing its two main parts: the Solver (dashed box) and the Executor. Varied-length input data enters the Solver's Sequence Blaster (§4.2), which performs Micro-batch Chunking so batches aren't too large, producing Chunked Micro-batches (visualized as small cards of colored bars of differing lengths). These pass to the Parallelism Planner (§4.1), which first does Sequence Bucketing, then Parallelism Solving to compute the optimal combination of parallelism strategies, formulated as a linear program. The resulting Optimal Plan flows down to the Executor, which runs the current training iteration, while italic annotations note the Solver simultaneously prefetches and plans the next iteration in parallel with the Executor's current-iteration run. Dark-blue title bars and light-blue bodies distinguish the two solver components from the plain blue Executor box.
